info.title: Fengshui Trainer API
info.description: API documentation for Fengshui Trainer platform

post.description:
Logout: client nên gửi { "refresh": "<refresh_token>" } để server blacklist token.
Nếu không gửi, vẫn 205 (client xóa token ở local) nhưng refresh token vẫn dùng được đến hết hạn.

Takes a refresh type JSON web token and returns an access type JSON web
token if the refresh token is valid.

get.description: GET /api/books/{slug}/ - Book detail with chapters; has_purchased if auth.
GET /api/exams/ - List exams (filter by module, exam_type).
GET /api/exams/{slug}/ - Exam detail with questions (no correct_answer).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results to return per page.

post.description: POST /api/payments/purchase-book/ - Deduct LT, grant book access.
POST /api/payments/purchase-video/ - Deduct LT, grant video access.
POST /api/payments/subscribe-vip/ - Deduct LT, extend VIP status.

get.description: GET/PUT /api/users/me/ - Get or update current user profile.

put.description: GET/PUT /api/users/me/ - Get or update current user profile.

patch.description: GET/PUT /api/users/me/ - Get or update current user profile.

get.description: GET /api/users/me/device-status/ - Show bound device and next reset date.
GET /api/videos/{slug}/ - Course detail with lessons; has_purchased if auth.
GET /api/videos/{slug}/lessons/{lesson_slug}/ - Lesson detail with video URL.
GET /api/wallet/history/ - Paginated list of user's WalletTransactions.
